shots.prompt: The sky shakes, islands start breaking apart, bridges collapse
lines: NARRATOR
Elyra was falling.

shots.prompt: People run across falling islands screaming
lines: NARRATOR
Thousands of people. No ground beneath their feet.
Binlerce insan. Ayaklarının altında zemin yok.

shots.prompt: A bridge snaps and swings down into the clouds
lines: NARRATOR
Bridges built over three hundred years broke in a single minute.
Üç yüz yılda kurulan köprüler bir dakikada kırıldı.

shots.prompt: He shouts over the wind
lines: KAEL
She's draining the islands! They'll all fall!

shots.prompt: He holds his chest in pain
lines: RYAN
I can feel them. The islands are scared.

shots.prompt: Two islands collide in slow motion, rocks exploding
lines: NARRATOR
The sky itself was coming apart.
Gökyüzünün kendisi parçalanıyordu.

shots.prompt: Ryan kneels and sings, crystals glow and slow the falling islands
lines: NARRATOR
Ryan sang louder than he had ever sung.
Ryan hiç olmadığı kadar yüksek sesle şarkı söyledi.

shots.prompt: She looks toward the fortress
lines: ASHLEY
The core. We have to reach the core.

shots.prompt: Ryan's crystals form a glowing net under a falling island
Ashley, Kai and Ava run into the fortress through collapsing halls
lines: NARRATOR
The Fortress was collapsing around them. They ran into it anyway.
Kale etraflarında çöküyordu. Yine de içine koştular.

shots.prompt: Red lights flash, walls crack, guards stagger
The friends dodge falling beams in the corridor
They burst into the glowing core chamber, a giant crystal pulses
lines: NARRATOR
At the heart of the Fortress, someone had been waiting for three hundred years.

shots.prompt: A calm woman's face made of light opens her eyes inside the crystal
lines: EKIN
Hello, Ashley. I am Doctor Ekin Var. I made you.

shots.prompt: The giant crystal pulses faster and faster
lines: NARRATOR
The core was failing. Time was running out.
Çekirdek tükeniyordu. Zaman azalıyordu.

shots.prompt: She steps back in shock
lines: ASHLEY
You made me? Then what is the Shadow?

shots.prompt: The crystal face looks sad and kind
lines: EKIN
My first try. I left her unfinished. That was my mistake.

shots.prompt: The Shadow clenches her fists, red light crackling
lines: NARRATOR
Three hundred years of anger. Ready to explode.
Üç yüz yıllık öfke. Patlamaya hazır.

shots.prompt: He holds Ashley's hand
lines: KAI
Then she's not evil. She's just alone.

shots.prompt: Outside, an island cracks in half and starts to sink
lines: NARRATOR
Every second, another piece of Elyra fell into the clouds.
Her saniye, Elyra'nın bir parçası daha bulutlara düşüyordu.

shots.prompt: Nyra smashes through glass and lands in a crouch
The Shadow walks into the core chamber, red eyes glowing
lines: SHADOW
You got everything, Twenty-Three. I got nothing.

shots.prompt: She answers softly
lines: ASHLEY
Then let me share it with you.

shots.prompt: Islands tilt as people jump to safety
The Shadow hesitates, her red eyes flickering
lines: NARRATOR
For the first time, the Shadow didn't know what to do.
Gölge ilk kez ne yapacağını bilemedi.

shots.prompt: Sila storms in with guards, laughing
lines: SILA
How sweet. Now everyone falls together.

shots.prompt: Ava jumps in front of the others, staff blazing
Nyra crashes through a window and lands between Sila and the group
She raises her spear at Sila
lines: NYRA
Number Four reporting. On the right side.

shots.prompt: Islands continue to fall, a huge crack rips across the sky
lines: NARRATOR
There was only one way to save Elyra. Wake them all.

shots.prompt: The 22 capsules beneath the fortress flicker
